abstract: Choriocarcinoma- and yolk sac tumor-like differentiation have rarely been reported in gastric cancers. We report a case of gastric adenocarcinoma, concurrently possessing choriocarcinoma and yolk sac tumor components, of a 74-year-old man. A hemorrhagic, 11 × 8 × 3 cm, tumor with ulceration was located in the body and pre-pylorus of the stomach. Histological examination of the resected specimens demonstrated intermingled proliferation of three different components, namely, adenocarcinoma, choriocarcinoma and yolk sac tumor, which were immunoreactive for carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA), beta-subunit of human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG) and alpha-fetoprotein (AFP), respectively. Gastric cancers with germ cell tumor components are uncommon and this is the second reported case of gastric cancer with choriocarcinoma and yolk sac tumor components.
abstract_ja: 胃癌における絨毛癌様および卵黄嚢腫瘍様分化はまれにしか報告されていない。74歳男性の胃腺癌に絨毛癌および卵黄嚢腫瘍成分が同時に存在する症例を報告する。胃の体部から前庭部にかけて、潰瘍を伴う出血性の11×8×3 cmの腫瘍を認めた。切除標本の組織学的検査では、腺癌、絨毛癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍の3つの成分が混在して増殖しており、それぞれCEA（癌胎児性抗原）、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)のβサブユニット、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)に免疫反応性を示した。胚細胞腫瘍成分を伴う胃癌はまれであり、絨毛癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を伴う胃癌の報告は本例が2例目である。
